elements.label: Field-settings side panel closing, header toolbar (Comment / Share / About this view / search) revealed
Fields button returns from active (dark) to idle state
Delivery progress and competitive-slider columns shifting right as the Bucket column is inserted

pattern.description: Screen recording: the field-settings side panel closes, the header toolbar returns, and the ideas table re-lays out with a newly shown Bucket column (chips) pushing the delivery-progress and slider columns right.
pattern.why_premium: The newly enabled field lands in context in one beat right after the narration says 'easy to toggle', so the viewer sees the consequence of the toggle without a cut.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline: panel gsap.to(x: '100%', autoAlpha: 0, 0.25s, power2.in); at 0.1s gsap.fromTo toolbar + avatars {autoAlpha:0} -> {autoAlpha:1, 0.2s, power1.out}; Fields button backgroundColor tween 0.15s; right-hand columns gsap.from(x: -110, 0.3s, power3.out) via Flip; Bucket header + chips fromTo {autoAlpha:0, y:4} -> {autoAlpha:1, y:0, stagger:0.03, power2.out}.
build_hint.remotion: Panel translateX = interpolate(frame,[0,8],[0,width]) with Easing.in(Easing.quad); columns translateX from spring({damping:30, stiffness:200}) (no overshoot); chips opacity = interpolate(frame - i, [6,12],[0,1]) per row.

notes: Live screen recording, likely a near-instant UI state change rather than authored motion; intermediate frames show the table reflowing mid-transition. Cursor on the competitive slider (75 tooltip) has no own candidate box and is not listed.
